t: In front of you is the statue of William Shakespeare, the centrepiece of Leicester Square Gardens since 1874. The sculptor Giovanni Fontana made it, after an original by Peter Scheemakers, and James Thomas Knowles designed it. Shakespeare is widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language. He left some thirty-nine plays and a hundred and fifty-four sonnets, and his plays are performed more often than those of any other playwright. It seems fitting that he stands at the heart of London's theatreland.
